description: This file defines an Express.js route handler for the '/api/costs/details' endpoint, which retrieves and processes cost data related to language model usage, grouped by user, project, and agent, with support for filtering by date range and user ID. It includes complex aggregation pipeline construction for MongoDB, data normalization, and response formatting.

methods.name: parseIsoDate
methods.description: Utility function to parse an ISO date string into a Date object, returning null if invalid.
